id: \bWhat are you looking for?
en: \bWhat are you looking for?
it: \bCosa stai cercando?

id: Oh.
en: Oh.
it: Oh.

id: \bI actually forgot where the switch is.
en: \bI actually forgot where the switch is.
it: \bA dire il vero ho dimenticato dov'è l'interruttore.

id: \bStop! I'm gonna beat you!
en: \bStop! I'm gonna beat you!
it: \bFermo! Ti batterò!

id: Ugh.
en: Ugh.
it: Uff.

id: \bWe used to have a Gym on the island. I miss it.
en: \bWe used to have a Gym on the island. I miss it.
it: \bUna volta avevamo una Palestra sull'isola. Mi manca.

id: The switch has been activated.
en: The switch has been activated.
it: L'interruttore è stato attivato.

id: The lava is moving out of the volcano!
en: The lava is moving out of the volcano!
it: La lava sta defluendo dal vulcano!

id: \bBlaine: So you beat the Mansion? Good for you.
en: \bBlaine: So you beat the Mansion? Good for you.
it: \bBlaine: Hai superato la villa, eh? Buon per te.

id: \bThat place is actually part of the abandoned Gym we used to use, but I thought the volcano was a better place for a Gym.
en: \bThat place is actually part of the abandoned Gym we used to use, but I thought the volcano was a better place for a Gym.
it: \bQuel posto in realtà fa parte della vecchia Palestra abbandonata, ma ho pensato che il vulcano fosse un posto migliore per una Palestra.

id: \bWell anyways, let's get to the battle.
en: \bWell anyways, let's get to the battle.
it: \bComunque, passiamo alla lotta.

id: \bBlaine: Did you hear that? It sounded like the volcano is acting up again.
en: \bBlaine: Did you hear that? It sounded like the volcano is acting up again.
it: \bBlaine: Hai sentito? Sembra che il vulcano stia dando di nuovo segni di vita.

id: \bHead up higher and hit the switch. It runs the excess lava out of the volcano.
en: \bHead up higher and hit the switch. It runs the excess lava out of the volcano.
it: \bSali più in alto e premi l'interruttore. Fa defluire la lava in eccesso fuori dal vulcano.

id: \bWe can continue our battle afterwards.
en: \bWe can continue our battle afterwards.
it: \bPotremo continuare la nostra lotta dopo.

id: \bBlaine: The switch is up higher. Hurry!
en: \bBlaine: The switch is up higher. Hurry!
it: \bBlaine: L'interruttore è più in alto. Sbrigati!

id: \bBlaine: Good job kid! Let's get back to our battle, shall we?
en: \bBlaine: Good job kid! Let's get back to our battle, shall we?
it: \bBlaine: Ottimo lavoro, ragazzo! Torniamo alla nostra lotta, che ne dici?

id: \bBlaine: That was great! Here, take the Volcano Badge.
en: \bBlaine: That was great! Here, take the Volcano Badge.
it: \bBlaine: È stato grandioso! Ecco, prendi la Medaglia Vulcano.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM35 contains Flamethrower. A scorching attack that can burn the opponent.
en: \bTM35 contains Flamethrower. A scorching attack that can burn the opponent.
it: \bL'MT35 contiene Lanciafiamme. Un attacco rovente che può scottare l'avversario.

id: \bThat's your 7th badge huh?\nWhy not try out the Viridian Gym next? I hear they have a very powerful Gym Leader there.
en: \bThat's your 7th badge huh?\nWhy not try out the Viridian Gym next? I hear they have a very powerful Gym Leader there.
it: \bÈ la tua settima medaglia, eh?\nPerché non provi la Palestra di Smeraldopoli? Ho sentito che c'è un Capopalestra molto potente.

id: \bBlaine: Come back and visit the island anytime!
en: \bBlaine: Come back and visit the island anytime!
it: \bBlaine: Torna a trovarci sull'isola quando vuoi!

id: \bBlaine likes to enhance his Fire types by being in a volcano.
en: \bBlaine likes to enhance his Fire types by being in a volcano.
it: \bA Blaine piace potenziare i suoi tipi Fuoco stando in un vulcano.

id: Smoked me.
en: Smoked me.
it: Mi hai incenerito.

id: \bIt's too hot in here.
en: \bIt's too hot in here.
it: \bFa troppo caldo qui dentro.

id: \bWhy are you up here?
en: \bWhy are you up here?
it: \bPerché sei quassù?

id: Strong.
en: Strong.
it: Forte.

id: \bHurry up and leave.
en: \bHurry up and leave.
it: \bSbrigati ad andartene.

id: \bI'm always afraid of the volcano exploding.
en: \bI'm always afraid of the volcano exploding.
it: \bHo sempre paura che il vulcano esploda.

id: I was distracted.
en: I was distracted.
it: Ero distratto.

id: \bWhat if the volcano went BOOM? Where would our Gym go?
en: \bWhat if the volcano went BOOM? Where would our Gym go?
it: \bE se il vulcano facesse BUM? Dove finirebbe la nostra Palestra?

id: \bBlaine uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
en: \bBlaine uses Fire type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Water, Ground, and Rock types.
it: \bBlaine usa Pokémon di tipo Fuoco. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Terra e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel. Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Bug, Grass, Ice, and Steel.  Bug, Grass, Fire, Ice, Steel, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Coleottero, Erba, Ghiaccio e Acciaio.  Anche le mosse di tipo Coleottero, Erba, Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Folletto non fanno molti danni.

id: \bBlaine is amazing. You agree right?
en: \bBlaine is amazing. You agree right?
it: \bBlaine è fantastico. Sei d'accordo, vero?

id: Blaine is much stronger.
en: Blaine is much stronger.
it: Blaine è molto più forte.

id: \bI used to steal for a living. Then I met Blaine.
en: \bI used to steal for a living. Then I met Blaine.
it: \bUna volta rubavo per vivere. Poi ho conosciuto Blaine.

id: \bThis is a great place to train body and mind.
en: \bThis is a great place to train body and mind.
it: \bQuesto è un ottimo posto per allenare corpo e mente.

id: I need to practice more.
en: I need to practice more.
it: Devo allenarmi di più.

id: \bHow did you get so strong?
en: \bHow did you get so strong?
it: \bCome hai fatto a diventare così forte?

id: Cinnabar Island Pokémon Gym Leader:\nBlaine
en: Cinnabar Island Pokémon Gym Leader:\nBlaine

en: The Hotheaded Quiz Master!
